Question ID: MCR_U06_L08_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: Unit 6 standards synthesis - MLA.MCR.GM.1 through MLA.MCR.GM.7

A scale drawing uses 1 inch for 8 feet. What real distance is represented by 5 inches?

feedback.text: This adds 8 and 5. Use the scale rate by multiplying.
Correct. 5 x 8 = 40 feet.
This represents only 1 inch on the drawing.
This ignores the scale rate.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: MCR_U06_L08_GP_Q02

MLA Standard: Unit 6 standards synthesis - MLA.MCR.GM.1 through MLA.MCR.GM.7

A rectangle has vertices (0,0), (6,0), (6,3), and (0,3). What is its area?

feedback.text: This adds width and height. Area requires multiplication.
The number is correct, but area needs square units.
This does not use the full rectangle dimensions. Area of a rectangle is length times width.
Correct. Area = 6 x 3 = 18 square units.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: MCR_U06_L08_GP_Q03

MLA Standard: Unit 6 standards synthesis - MLA.MCR.GM.1 through MLA.MCR.GM.7

A prism is 5 ft by 4 ft by 2 ft. What is its volume?

feedback.text: Correct. Volume = 5 x 4 x 2 = 40 cubic ft.
This adds dimensions. Volume requires multiplication.
This uses only two dimensions.
The number is correct, but volume uses cubic units.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: MCR_U06_L08_GP_Q04

MLA Standard: Unit 6 standards synthesis - MLA.MCR.GM.1 through MLA.MCR.GM.7

A right triangle has legs 9 and 12. What is the hypotenuse?

feedback.text: This adds the legs. Use the Pythagorean Theorem.
This multiplies the legs. Multiplication alone does not find c.
This is c², not c.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: MCR_U06_L08_GP_Q05

MLA Standard: Unit 6 standards synthesis - MLA.MCR.GM.1 through MLA.MCR.GM.7

Which final answer has the correct unit for density?

feedback.text: Cubic cm measures volume, not density.
Correct. Density compares mass to volume.
Square cm measures area.
Centimeters measure length.
